The '''Token Price Ticker''' is an embeddable, live price display for the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem tokens, part of the [[SoapBox Data Hub]] and published at data.soapbox.community/tools/ticker.

It is designed for people who want to show current [[KULA]] and other ecosystem token prices somewhere the [[SoapBox Data Hub]] cannot be embedded directly — a forum signature, a discussion post, or a blog.

== What it shows ==
The ticker lists the ecosystem tokens — MELEK, PRANA, WPRANA, [[KULA]], wVKBT, wCURE and APIS — with each token's current price expressed in PRANA, the [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]] chain's native token.

Prices come from the live [[KulaSwap]] automated-market-maker pool reserves read directly from the PRANA chain. KULA is priced from the KULA/WPRANA pool; wVKBT and wCURE are priced through their KULA pools. Tokens that have no market yet — MELEK (whose blockchain witness price feed is not live) and APIS — are shown honestly as '''n/a''' rather than with an invented number.

== How to use it ==
Three formats are offered on the embed page:
* '''Forum (BBCode)''' — a single [img] tag that renders a price image. It works on boards that allow images but not JavaScript, including Bitcointalk. The image is served as PNG through a public image proxy so it displays on the strictest forums.
* '''Blog (HTML)''' — an image tag or a small auto-refreshing widget for sites that allow HTML or JavaScript.
* '''JSON''' — a plain data endpoint for anyone who wants to read the prices programmatically.

Each format is copy-paste ready on the embed page; no account, key or signup is required.

== Design notes ==
The ticker never asks for or handles any private key, and reads only public chain data. If a pool or the chain is briefly unreachable, the affected token shows n/a and the rest of the ticker still renders — it never fails to a blank or an error.
